data.overview: A kind-hearted but clumsy guardian spirit tries to improve the life of an exhausted bicycle courier by swapping his circumstances with those of a powerful financier. The meddling produces unexpected consequences for both men—and for the celestial novice who meant well.
data.tagline: Good intentions can make a mess of heaven.
data.title: The Spare Halo
